notes: Every case is a new chart, its maps registered afresh as {svg: text}; animation false; a tooltip hides at once and sits at [5, 5].

Text is measured with zrender's width table (the server-side fallback): width = sum of ratio * font size over the characters, the font size the first number before px in the font string, a font with mono in it fontSize * length.
A click is mousemove, mousedown, mouseup, click; a drag moves between a press and a release, then a click; leave is the handler's mouseout.
After every step: chart._onframe() and a display-list refresh.
Region centres are asked once, after the first frame (GeoSVGRegion caches them).

cases.note: parseSVG over every node parser: the root svg reads its inline style only, a title / metadata / unknown tag is skipped with its children, defs and switch are passed through (an element in defs is not drawn, a gradient anywhere is a paint server), the attributes override the inline style, the inherited style goes down (opacity too), fill none, url(#id) fills (a missing id leaves the fill undefined), path data of every command, text with tspans (dx / dy, an absolute x / y, the text-anchor of the parent, alignment-baseline of the tspan itself, a font size under 9 scaled), visibility hidden, display none, an empty name, an image, a <g name> group; the default geo style on the named shapes

GeoSVGResource's bounding rect four ways: viewBox only (the viewBox), neither size nor viewBox (the content's own rect, the text measured), a width and a viewBox (x from 0, y from the viewBox), width '50%' (parseFloat: 50) with viewBox 'none'; and every transform the attribute knows, a viewBox of another aspect
an SVG that does not parse (mismatched tags) and a document whose root is not svg: registerMap throws, the map is not there, setOption throws on it
a projection written on an SVG map: the dev build drops it and then reads project off null -- setOption throws

the defaults on SVG regions: hover a named rect (the emphasis fill, z2 not lifted: z2EmphasisLift 0), a rect named B twice (only the one under the pointer), a child of the named group G (the whole group and its label), the named text T (events, no state), the stroke of a fill-less circle, a named rect N in the named group H (N alone), the curved path P, the unnamed background (nothing: silent), and leave
selectedMode 'multiple': a click selects every element of the name (both B), a click in the group G selects G, a click on the named text T toggles T; geoselectchanged before click; then 'single'

emphasis.focus 'self': every element of the SVG gets the default proxy and a blur state (_enableBlurEntireSVG) -- hovering a region blurs the unnamed background too, the hovered region in emphasis; leaving lifts the blur

region options on SVG regions: itemStyle over the SVG style (color replaces the fill, borderColor / borderWidth the stroke), emphasis / select / blur styles, labels shown with a formatter and a function formatter, a silent region, emphasis.disabled, areaColor over color; the geo itemStyle color on every named shape
the region tooltip (the region's string, the geo's template, a function), highlight / downplay by name (both B), geoSelect / geoUnSelect / geoToggleSelect
the roam on an SVG geo (drag, wheel, geoRoam), the hover kept, labels following; layoutCenter / layoutSize, aspectScale default 1, a centre and zoom in the option, clip

a map series on an SVG map with a continuous visualMap: the named regions coloured by value (a region without data keeps the default), the data appended for regions not in the data, the label rule, hover and select through the series, the tooltip
series on an SVG geo: scatter and effectScatter at SVG coordinates, a polyline of lines, a custom series (api.coord, api.size, coordSys), convertToPixel by series
